description: This file defines various enums, structs, and helpers related to execution approvals and security policies within the OpenClaw project. It includes configuration management, pattern validation, decision enums, and security states, along with some actor-based caching for skill binaries.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to the exec-approvals JSON file in the state directory.

methods.name: socketPath
methods.description: Returns the socket path used for exec approvals communication.

methods.name: normalizeIncoming
methods.description: Normalizes incoming ExecApprovalsFile data, including legacy pattern support and path trimming.

methods.name: readSnapshot
methods.description: Reads the current state of the exec-approvals file, returning a snapshot.

methods.name: redactForSnapshot
methods.description: Removes sensitive data from the ExecApprovalsFile for snapshot purposes.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads the ExecApprovalsFile from disk.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the provided ExecApprovalsFile to disk.

methods.name: ensureFile
methods.description: Ensures the exec-approvals file exists and loads it, creating default if necessary.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current approvals configuration for a given agentId, ensuring file exists.

methods.name: resolveReadOnly
methods.description: Loads approval configuration without writing, for read-only contexts.

methods.name: resolveFromFile
methods.description: Resolves approval settings from a provided ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: resolveDefaults
methods.description: Returns the default approval resolution settings.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Saves the given defaults configuration.

methods.name: updateDefaults
methods.description: Updates defaults with a mutation block.

methods.name: saveAgent
methods.description: Saves a specific agent's approval configuration.

methods.name: addAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern for an agent after validation.

methods.name: recordAllowlistUse
methods.description: Records usage of an allowlist pattern, command, and resolved path.

methods.name: updateAllowlist
methods.description: Updates an agent's allowlist entries with validation, returning rejected entries.

methods.name: updateAgentSettings
methods.description: Updates an agent's approval configuration with a mutation block.

methods.name: ensureSecureStateDirectory
methods.description: Creates and sets permissions on the secure state directory.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure token or UUID.

methods.name: hashRaw
methods.description: Computes a SHA256 hash of a raw string.

methods.name: hashFile
methods.description: Computes a SHA256 hash of an ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a shell path, including tilde expansion.

methods.name: agentKey
methods.description: Returns a trimmed key for agent lookup.

methods.name: normalizedPattern
methods.description: Validates and normalizes an allowlist pattern string.

methods.name: migrateLegacyPattern
methods.description: Migrates legacy pattern entries to new normalization rules.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a list of allowlist entries, dropping invalid if specified.

methods.name: mergeAgents
methods.description: Merges current and legacy agent configurations, combining allowlist entries uniquely.

methods.name: validateAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Validates an allowlist pattern to contain path components and not be empty.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks if a pattern qualifies as a path pattern.

methods.name: parseDecision
methods.description: Parses a raw string into an ExecApprovalDecision enum.

methods.name: requiresAsk
methods.description: Determines if an approval decision requires asking the user, based on settings.

methods.name: allowlistPattern
methods.description: Determines the pattern for a command or resolution.

methods.name: containsPathComponent
methods.description: Checks if a pattern contains path components like '/', '~', or '\'.

methods.name: truncateOutput
methods.description: Truncates output string to a maximum character limit with ellipsis.

methods.name: currentBins
methods.description: Returns the set of current skill bins, refreshing cache if stale.

methods.name: currentTrust
methods.description: Returns the trust index of skill bins, refreshing cache if stale.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the skill bins and trust index asynchronously.

methods.name: normalizeSkillBinName
methods.description: Normalizes a skill bin name by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedPath
methods.description: Normalizes a resolved path, standardizing it.

methods.name: buildTrustIndex
methods.description: Builds a trust index from skills report and search paths.

methods.name: resolveSkillBinPath
methods.description: Resolves the full path of a skill binary, checking if executable.

methods.name: isStale
methods.description: Checks if the cache is stale based on last refresh time.
